title: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol)
description: Understand how ARP resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses.
scenario: Understand how ARP resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses.

concepts.title: What is ARP?
concepts.body: ARP maps IP addresses to MAC addresses. When a device knows the IP but not the MAC, it broadcasts an ARP request.

concepts.title: ARP Process
concepts.body: 1. Check ARP cache. 2. If not found, broadcast ARP request. 3. Target replies with its MAC. 4. Cache the mapping.
concepts.code:
Step 1: Check ARP cache
Step 2: Broadcast ARP request
Step 3: Receive ARP reply
Step 4: Cache MAC

concepts.title: ARP Cache
concepts.body: "show ip arp" shows the ARP table. Entries expire after a timeout (typically 4 hours).
concepts.code:
SW1# show ip arp
Protocol  Address      Age  MAC Address
Internet  192.168.1.10  0   00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E
